web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's June trade data showed robust growth, with exports rising by 27% year-on-year and imports by 36% year-on-year, both surpassing economists' forecasts. This surge was driven by strong global demand for AI hardware and a rush by exporters to beat anticipated U.S. tariff hikes. The trade surplus also increased significantly, indicating the competitiveness and resilience of China's manufacturing sector.
